title: 2 Side-by-Side Houses +Rooftop Hot Tub (Sleeps 20)
description:
Stay together while enjoying your own space with this dual listing at Harmony Heights! Featuring two modern homes side by side, you’ll have 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 8 beds, and 2 private rooftops. Perfect for large groups, reunions, or bachelor/ette trips just minutes from Downtown Nashville.

The space
Together, these homes comfortably host up to 20 guests across 6 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms, and 8 beds. Both feature bright open-concept living areas, chef’s kitchens, and private rooftop patios—ideal for sipping morning coffee or enjoying evenings under the Nashville sky.

Unit 1 – Sleek Rooftop Retreat

2 bedrooms | 2 baths

Sleeping arrangements: 1 King, 2 Queens

Stylish modern finishes and cozy lounge areas

Unit 2 – Modern Rooftop Escape

3 bedrooms | 3 baths

Sleeping arrangements: 1 King, 4 Queens

Spacious layout with extra seating and dining space

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
